lines.en: I inch forward, stretching and bunching.
I stop when I reach the leaf's edge.

lines.zh: 我从一片叶子爬到另一片。
lines.en: I crawl from one leaf to the next.
I have many feet and move slowly.
I go around the water on the leaf.

lines.zh: 我爬过的地方留下细细的痕。
lines.en: A thin trail follows me.

lines.zh: 我探出前半身去想够下一片叶。
lines.en: I reach my front half toward the next leaf.
I bunch up, then stretch out.
I climb up the branch.

lines.zh: 我在叶背上转了个方向。
lines.en: I turn around on the leaf's underside.
I press my body to the leaf.
I move bit by bit toward the tip.
I cross two veins.
I'm slow, and I don't stop.
I go around an ant.
I lie on the leaf's underside, still.

lines.zh: 我只在叶子上，别处不去。
lines.en: I stay on leaves and nowhere else.
There's still a piece of leaf in my mouth.
My body is in several segments.

lines.zh: 我在叶脉交叉的地方歇着。
lines.en: I rest where two veins cross.
I look up and see the leaf's edge.
I've finished this stretch.
I wriggle slowly.
There are still plenty of leaves around.

lines.zh: 你把我连同叶子一起看了。
lines.en: You've looked at me and the leaf together.

lines.zh: 你伸手过来，我缩了一下。
lines.en: Your hand comes near and I flinch.
I'm covered in fine hairs that itch.

lines.zh: 你要把我挪到别的叶子上吗。
lines.en: Are you moving me to another leaf.
Off the leaf, I'll starve.
Your palm is warm and dry.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，只看见很大一片。
lines.en: I look up and see only something vast.
You mustn't set me on the ground.
I hold the leaf's edge.

lines.zh: 你要放就放在叶子上面。
lines.en: If you set me down, put me on a leaf.
It flattens half a segment.
I spit up a little green.

lines.zh: 我吐出一小口绿水，缩紧了。
lines.en: I spit a little green fluid and curl tighter.
My fine hairs stand up.
I drop to the leaf's underside.
I crawl very slowly now.
I rest beside a vein.
I'm still on the leaf — that's something.
I twist once; I'm still alive.
Is that a leaf.
I raise my head and sniff.
I can eat this one.
I crawl over, slowly.
I bite in from the edge.
I chew a small hole in it.
This leaf is still fresh.

lines.zh: 我吃得很慢，可一直在吃。
lines.en: I eat slowly, and I never stop.
I don't want anything else.

lines.zh: 叶子没了我就不知道怎么办了。
lines.en: Without leaves I wouldn't know what to do.

lines.zh: 你碰了我一下，我缩成团。
lines.en: You touch me and I curl up.
I slip off the leaf.
I catch the leaf's edge.
I wobble on the leaf's surface.
The knock bends the leaf.
I press to a vein and steady.

lines.zh: 我抓着一根叶脉，没掉下去。
lines.en: I cling to a leaf vein and don't fall.
Watch your step — I'm on this leaf.
She's on the same branch.
We crawl toward each other, slowly.
She has one segment fewer than I do.
Our heads touch once.
Her hairs are paler than mine.

lines.zh: 我们趴在叶背上一动不动。
lines.en: We lie still on the leaf's underside.
She heads for the tip; I follow.

lines.zh: 这一片叶子够我们两个吃。
lines.en: This leaf will feed us both.
We crawl apart.
I chew in from the edge, bite by bite.
I chew a winding trench.
I stop at the vein.

lines.zh: 这一片就快被我吃光了。
lines.en: I've almost finished this leaf.
My mouth is full of leaf bits.
I let out a thin thread.
I hang myself on a thread.
I work around the leaf's rim.
I'm eating faster and faster.
When it's done, it's time to spin.
There are more leaves ahead.

lines.zh: 前面那片嫩叶，我够得着。
lines.en: That young leaf ahead is within my reach.
I crawl toward that patch of green.

lines.zh: 我闻到叶子被咬过的味道。
lines.en: I smell a leaf already bitten.
I go over slowly.

lines.zh: 叶子在那边，别的都不重要。
lines.en: The leaf is there; nothing else matters.

lines.zh: 我得从叶脉那边绕过去。
lines.en: I'll have to go around that vein.
I'm almost to it.
I reach out and bite.

lines.zh: 丛林很热，我挪一步歇一步。
lines.en: The jungle is hot, I move and rest by turns.
The gap between is a little wide.
I stretch my head across to test.
I've reached the far leaf's edge.
I drag the rest of me over.
I grip the leaf vein and do not let go.
I steady myself on the leaf.
I start eating from this end.
The leaf shrinks under my jaws.
I still haven't had my fill.
I rear my head and bump you.
My fine hairs prickle your hand.
I twist and push at you.
I spit out a thread.
The silk sticks to your finger.
I fall off the leaf.
On the ground I curl up.
I can't crawl back, so I wait.
I twist once more.
I hatch on the underside of a leaf.
My body is still soft.
I take a first bite of leaf.
The leaf is right at my mouth.
I begin to crawl.
Everything here is green.
Ants walk past me.
I don't dare leave this leaf.
I mean to eat this whole one.

lines.zh: 叶子一烧，我拼命往回缩。
lines.en: The leaf burns and I shrink back hard.
Water soaks right through me.
The blast shreds the leaf.

lines.zh: 一根东西扎穿了我的身子。
lines.en: Something pierces right through me.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的毛都竖了。
lines.en: The light makes every hair stand up.

lines.zh: 没有叶子，我在慢慢干瘪。
lines.en: No leaves; I'm slowly shrivelling.

lines.zh: 脚下没有叶子，只是一直落。
lines.en: No leaf beneath me; I just keep falling.
